_comment: Event desk: earnings/news briefings by email. Read-only; nothing here trades or recommends trades. Jev (TypeSafe) reads headlines once a key is in the Keychain (service typesafe-jev); until then the emails run on code alone and say so.

watchlist._comment: Every ticker on the TradingView watchlist, read from flip-notifier's expected-symbols.json. The flip-watchlist-sync task rewrites that file from the live watchlist each weekday 08:33, so it holds the watchlist's first 25 symbols (the Scanner's slot count).

biopharma._comment: Top 10 health-care names by event impact, from ~/market-iv-agent's latest snapshot. impact = weights over: explode score (priced-in event size, 0-100), proximity of the nearest dated catalyst or earnings (1 at today, 0 at event_window_days), and news intensity (Jev-judged material headlines; unjudged headlines count at half weight). Impact is about event SIZE, never direction. Since 2026-09-24 this is the ONE consolidated bio/pharma email: market-iv-agent runs in handoff mode and sends nothing itself; its 09:45 run's spread tickets lead this email and its full report is embedded at the end.

jev._comment: Per-headline judgments. Thresholds are for the email labels only; every raw answer is logged in data/judged.jsonl for later scoring.

sectors._comment: One email per S&P sector (S&P 500 + Nasdaq-100 + Dow 30, ~517 names), each built exactly like the bio/pharma email: 2-5 act-on bull call spreads, top 10 by event impact, full IV report. Settings are the biopharma block's numbers plus overrides; each sector's data comes from ~/market-iv-agent/data/sectors/<key>/ (the IV agent run with --profile <key>). Health care stays the bio/pharma email.
